text:
sam_newhire: Hey all — first day! Trying to finish Okta device enrollment from my Windows laptop using WSL2 (Ubuntu). Browser inside WSL throws 'Unsupported device type' and the 1Password invite never arrived. Getting blocked by SSO. Anyone seen this? @it_ops :confused:
it_ops: Welcome! We see this a bit with WSL - Okta Verify & browser flows expect a non-WSL user-agent. Quick Qs: is this a company laptop or personal? Did you try the system default browser (Edge/Chrome) outside WSL?
alex_devex: If it's personal, easiest is to complete the Okta + 1Password links from Windows host browser (not WSL). For Okta Verify use the phone app and scan the QR. For 1Password the invite is sent to your work email — check spam and also the alias folder. If the invite link expired we can reissue.
sam_newhire: It's personal for now. I did try Chrome on Windows but the edge popup says "device not supported" when it starts the enrollment flow. I do have a security key (not company-issued) plugged in but Windows doesn't pick it up while WSL is running.
it_ops: Ok. Two quick fixes: 1) try opening a private/incognito window in the host browser and paste the Okta device enrollment link (we can send one). 2) If you want us to avoid device enrollment for now, we can create a temporary bypass for 24h so you can finish onboarding. Which do you prefer?
sam_newhire: Bypass would be great — stuck on other setup tasks. Phone number for SMS OK?
it_ops: Yep please DM your mobile and the laptop hostname. We'll add a temporary exception. Also sending a fresh 1Password invite now.
okta-bot: [system] Device enrollment bypass requested by it_ops for user sam_newhire — expires 24h from 2027-04-05T14:11:50Z. Ticket #IT-4729 created.
maria_onboarding: Hi @sam_newhire — welcome again! Once it_ops confirms bypass, ping me and I'll onboard you to the #eng and #devex channels and share the quickstart checklist. Also if you want the company laptop image, we can ship it but expect 3-5 business days. :party_parrot:
sam_newhire: Got the new 1Password invite and accepted it — thanks! Locked down MFA step shows up now. I verified on phone with Okta Verify and completed the setup. Everything looks good. Thanks everyone :raised_hands: 
it_ops: Great — closing the temporary bypass. If any service still complains about group membership (GPU access or prod read-only), tag me and alex_devex and we'll add the right Okta groups.
alex_devex: FYI if you need the 1Password CLI later on WSL, install via: `brew install --cask 1password` on Windows with WSL2 + WinPkg or follow 1Password's Linux CLI install guide. Hit us up for SSH key onboarding after you confirm git access.
sam_newhire: Confirmed git access works. Appreciate the fast help!
